# hg edge

**What this page tells you:** every `hg edge` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

The tunnel and access policy: prove, publish, unpublish, list.

## Synopsis

```text
hg edge prove [flags]
hg edge publish [flags]
hg edge unpublish [flags]
hg edge list
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## `hg edge prove`

```text
hg edge prove [flags]
```

Live-verify the tunnel + access the pulumi stack provisioned, against the real account.

API-token permission preflight, stack outputs, DNS propagation, unauth + bogus-token denial on every Access-gated hostname, no-Access webhook hostnames reachable unauthenticated, undeclared hostnames unpublished, no public Service bypass (`--kubeconfig`), `pulumi preview --expect-no-changes`.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--stack` | `<stack>` | — | The Pulumi stack to verify. |
| `--infra-dir` | `<path>` | — | The Pulumi program directory. |
| `--kubeconfig` | `<path>` | — | Also assert no public Service bypasses the edge. |
| `--skip-idempotency` | — | — | Skip the `pulumi preview --expect-no-changes` leg. |

## `hg edge publish`

```text
hg edge publish [flags]
```

Publish a temporary test url for one in-cluster service.

Gated by a Zero Trust Access app admitting only `--email`; the connector runs in namespace `hg-edge-test` (plain kubectl, no Helm). Prints the `https://` URL.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--app` | `<match>` | — | The in-cluster app to expose. |
| `--email` | `<a>[,b]` | — | Who the Access policy admits. |
| `--hostname` | `<label>` | — | Hostname label under the zone. |
| `--zone` | `<name>` | — | The Cloudflare zone. |
| `--service` | `<ns>/<name>:<port>` | — | Expose a Service directly instead of matching an app. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg edge publish --app nexus --email ops@example.com
hg edge unpublish --all
```

## `hg edge unpublish`

```text
hg edge unpublish [flags]
```

Tear a published test url down as one unit: dns, access app+policy, tunnel, connector.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--hostname` | `<label>` | — | Which published URL to tear down. |
| `--all` | — | — | Tear down every published test URL. |

## `hg edge list`

```text
hg edge list
```

The currently published test urls.
